content: 1. Glycopyrronium tosylate (topical) and hyoscyamine may enhance each other's anticholinergic effects through pharmacodynamic synergy. Co-administration can lead to additive anticholinergic adverse effects. It is recommended to avoid or use alternative drugs. If used together, monitor closely. 2. Hyoscyamine can decrease the levels of haloperidol by inhibiting gastrointestinal (GI) absorption, which applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Additionally, hyoscyamine may antagonize haloperidol pharmacodynamically, while haloperidol may enhance the effects of hyoscyamine through pharmacodynamic synergy. Use caution and monitor closely. 3.
